overview.text: Soil_1_10 is a biosynthetic gene cluster identified solely by DeepBGC, with no compound class assigned.
It spans 49 kb on contig_1 from position 936,108 to 985,530 and contains 46 genes.

genes.text: The cluster includes 9 regulatory, 2 transport, 15 tailoring-enzyme, and 2 resistance genes, with 2 core genes identified by DeepBGC.
CJLEIP_00811 is annotated as an Acyl-CoA synthetase and is a core gene.
CJLEIP_00812 is annotated as an AMP-binding protein and is a core gene.

similar.text: No comparison with MIBiG has been made, as antiSMASH did not detect this locus.

hypothesis.text: The presence of xanthine dehydrogenase subunits and accessory factors, along with oxidoreductases and transcriptional regulators, suggests the cluster may be involved in purine degradation rather than specialised metabolite production.

facts.sentence: Soil_1_10 is a biosynthetic gene cluster, found by DeepBGC only; no compound class is assigned to it.
It spans 49 kb on contig_1 (936,108–985,530) and contains 46 genes.
By the annotation categories of BGC-XPLORER, it holds 9 regulatory, 2 transport, 15 tailoring-enzyme and 2 resistance genes.
DeepBGC names 2 core genes in the locus.
CJLEIP_00811, annotated by Bakta as Acyl-CoA synthetase, is named as a core gene by DeepBGC.
CJLEIP_00812, annotated by Bakta as AMP-binding protein, is named as a core gene by DeepBGC.
